name: Green-Meldrim House

dates.altered: The survey's own alterations line reads 'Stucco removed after 1934.'; the Library's item record adds 'after 1943 Subsequent Work'.
dates.note: The survey form prints 'begun 1853, finished 1861' and the Library's item record '1853-1861 Initial Construction'; the Wikipedia infobox prints 'Built 1853'. The survey names the architect 'John S. Harris (?)', with its own question mark; Wikipedia gives John S. Norris. Both are recorded and neither is resolved -- this is a 1934 inventory form and its attribution is explicitly uncertain.

refs.title: Green-Meldrim House, 327 Bull Street, Savannah, Chatham County, GA
refs.note: The survey number is printed on the inventory form itself ('GREEN-MELDRIM HOUSE HABS NO. GA-222') and confirmed by the Library's item record. The form is the 1934 district-officer inventory shape, not the later Part I/Part II outline, so its fields are headings in capitals rather than numbered paragraphs.
Read as JSON by appending `?fo=json` to this path, which is the only route to the Library's catalogue record from this container.

measurements.name: overall_dimensions_as_printed
measurements.note: Recorded as printed and deliberately NOT parsed into a width. A 641 ft front beside a 56 ft depth is not a two-storey Savannah town house on a Madison Square trust lot, so the leading digit is OCR noise of some kind; which digit is wrong cannot be told from this page, and guessing 64 would be an inference wearing a quotation.

measurements.name: overall_depth_ft
measurements.note: The second figure printed. The survey does not say which face is the front; the first figure is unparseable (above), so this one is recorded alone and is a depth only on the schema's first-figure-is-width convention.
